task_description: Add read-only hierarchical drill-down detail routes to the Standards catalog screen of the Aurinara frontend: product -> versions -> assets/compatibilities; terminology release -> codelists -> terms; template -> versions. Reuse ResourceTable/PageHeader/StatusBadge/states, add a shared DetailHeader, flat param routes keyed on each entity's own id. No mutations, no new deps, no edits to generated files. Gate: npm run build + npm run lint from frontend dir.
